description: Pittston, PA - Congressman Rob Bresnahan today announced the unified endorsement of his re-election campaign by four national maritime labor unions representing the licensed and unlicensed merchant mariners who keep America's commercial fleet moving: the American Maritime Officers (AMO), the International Organization of Masters, Mates & Pilots (MM&P), the Marine Engineers' Beneficial Association (MEBA), and the Seafarers International Union (SIU).
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Bresnahan Earns Unified Endorsement from Four Maritime Unions - Rob for PA
